reviews.text: It's better that I'm reading the reviews, because I was going to bring my kitten.
The staff is very professional,I have a husky he is going to be dramatic regardless lol ,the staff handle his shoots very well , definitely recommend this to anyone in the area
I wouldn't take my pet's any where else.  An amazing  hospital. Thank you for your  services.
Coming here is a waiting game  been in room waiting for vet to check our dog out. And others  pets have been seen 1st been here since 10am for god sakes its now 11ish
Always take my dog here. They are fast cheaper then most vets and don't make you pay for extra unnecessary things. Vets are so nice to the pets and truly do God's work

Some time ago we took one of my cats called Tilín, they took care of him very well and today it was Mishe's emergency appointment, without an appointment and although we waited a little they attended him in a very professional way. The doctor gave us advice for his problem and the assistants helped and took care of my cat with affection. The doctor thought he wouldn't be able to with him because he's big but my cats are calm

We brought our senior cat in for an emergency euthanasia after calling ahead, expecting he would be seen promptly. Instead, we waited nearly an hour without anyone attending to him. During that time, our beloved cat continued to suffer and ultimately passed away in the car while we were still waiting.

No family should have to watch a cherished pet spend their final moments in pain because emergency care was delayed. We understand veterinary clinics can be busy, but better communication and triage are essential in situations like this. This was a heartbreaking and devastating experience that we will never forget.

PLEASE save yourself the heartache and do not take your loved ones here. My cat suffered because I chose to bring here instead of another clinic. I know the vet here likes to respond to the negative reviews and shame them with zero empathy, so I brought the call log as proof. I called Marquette Animal Hospital because it was the closest vet to me. In the morning at 9 I woke up to my cat shallow breathing and unable to move. I called Marquette and asked if I could take my cat in for euthanasia and told them exactly what was going on. I called because I wanted to make sure they could see us right away, or else I would go to a different vet. The receptionist said “yes you can bring her in, call us when you’re in the parking lot.” I called at 9:32am to let her know we were in the parking lot. They spent 5 minutes asking if I was going to do cremation, whether I wanted a paw print, trying to get all my information down. And they said they would call us back shortly once a room was available.

My cat was not seen until almost an hour later. I called at 9:51am to see what was going on, because I kept seeing other people going into the building. The receptionist said “they called before you did so you’ll have to wait. She asked, “is your pet still alive?” And I again repeated that she was barely breathing. They did not call us in until 10:19am. The receptionist did not even greet us as we walked into the building. We waited in Room 2 for ANOTHER 10 MINUTES. Do you want to check that on camera Dr. Bhandal? Because I know you LOVE criticizing the bad reviews instead of just apologizing. At 10:32 the nurse finally came into the room and still wanted to weigh my cat. OMG. I could not believe it. My cat passed away on the table, struggling to breathe while the nurse was trying to weigh her.

I will never, ever go to this animal hospital again. And I will spend the rest of my life telling every single soul that will listen to me to NOT go here for the beloved pets. I called before leaving my house so I could avoid this from happening, and it still happened! Bhandal is going to reply saying “if this was an emergency you should have gone to an emergency room vet.” You don’t think you should’ve told me that BEFORE I made the trip to your clinic when I called with my situation and they still told me to come in?? This man and this clinic is unbelievable.
Terrible. They said they weren't attending to anyone because the doctor wasn't there and wouldn't arrive until Thursday. I mean, if he's not there, why is it open? What's the point?

When my cat Miklo was still alive I took him in for a small sore on his head snd he was seen immediately and diagnosed correctly. I took my dog here for her allergies and shots and the prices are fitting for everything. The doctors, vet techs and staff are very kind and respectful. Ive even taken my younger cat storm here and she is all better and doing very well. This place isnt by appointment its first come. Waiting isnt that long they try to get you in as quickly as possible and diagnose your pet as best as they can. I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone who are afraid of trusting other vets or price issues.

This is a good clinic. I came in for my cat and the doctor and staff were sincere, respectful, and very helpful. I wouldn’t rank it as the best in Chicago but mind you, it is very affordable, is a WALK-IN clinic, and VERY little wait time!— majority of vets are by appointment only, and will charge you an arm and a leg.

Whoever is the receptionist is needs to get training on how to answer the phone and how to speak to people.
I called to possibly make a appointment for my pet I greeted her good morning I would like to bring my pet in, no good morning or anything she replied “we’re not taking new patients, call around”. They’re many nice and professional ways she could have responded. Very disappointed. Do better please you don’t know what people are going through.
